National Laboratory of the Rockies | 12 MADRL for Cell-Based Restoration MADRL for Cell-Based Restoration Bilevel cell cluster algorithm  Upper level: o Perform cell connection/clustering based on resilience metrics and evaluate the stability o Treat each cell as an aggregated element o Decide switch actions to connect/cluster cells o Deploy MBESS as kWh  Lower level: o Existing cell clustering for restoration (CLR) agents running in all cells o Interact with a new coordination agent (COR): ❖COR: ❑Execute the switch actions decided in upper level. ❑Coordinate the load pickup in clustered cells. ❖COR is running in parallel with CLR agents with the same time resolution. o MADRL; centralized training and decentralized implementation.
